title: THIS DOES NOT WORK UNDER ROUND BASED RECLINERS!
text:
THIS DOES NOT WORK UNDER ROUND BASED RECLINERS!. This product is advertised as being able to be used “under… recliners.” Again, another well made misrepresented product! I am good at measurements and spatial relationships. I gave this one my all before ordering. I even designed a large shim to oppose the feet as I understood I would have to counterbalance the height of the metal foot pads. Did so to within 1/16th of the pad weight. Had to hire someone to come over and tilt the recliner up a bit so I could slide the feet in. What a waste of time and money!
It started lurching widely to the right in a day. It interfered with the recliner mechanism. Are we never to use a recliner as a recliner? Soon after that it worked its way completely out from the recliner base! Next, I even thought about asking a metal shop to make a back side brace, decided that was just too much and tried to live with it askew to the front so I could use it free standing. No dice!
Using a product like this just shouldn’t be that hard. SO BEWARE! If you have a recliner that has feet as shown on the product site it may work, that is if it doesn’t mess with your reclining mechanism. And if you have a solid round wood base-DON’T BELIEVE THEM WHEN THEY SAY IT WORKS “WITH RECLINERS!”

Easy Assembly: Install the sofa desk under the feet of most four legged lift chairs or recliners with feet 25 to 35 inches apart; each tray includes all the needed equipment for assembly, no additional tools required; not intended for freestanding use

Modern Design: The galaxy brown frame and bamboo tray will seamlessly blend with the style of your home, making it the perfect living room addition; with 360 degrees of swivel motion, easily pivot the tray table out of the way when not in use

Super Grip Stability Pads: The dual sided rubber pads can be adjusted to fit the distance between the front and back legs of your furniture and will protect your floor from damage; furniture feet can be placed on either the outside or inside of the pads

Fully Adjustable: The tray height adjusts from 24 to 32 inches; base length adjusts from 25 to 35 inches; please reference our assembly video and infographics to determine if the Universal Swivel Tray is compatible with your furniture
